```gherkin
Feature: Services within a radius of 25 sqkm or specified PinCodes

  Scenario: Services offered within a radius of 25 sqkm
    Given the hospital is located at (12.345, 78.901)
    And the radius is set to 25 sqkm
    When a patient registers with an address within the radius
    Then the patient can register and apply for appointments/consultation requests

  Scenario: Services offered within specified PinCodes
    Given the hospital is located at (12.345, 78.901)
    And the PinCodes are set to (123456, 789012)
    When a patient registers with an address matching one of the PinCodes
    Then the patient can register and apply for appointments/consultation requests

  Scenario: Patient cannot register outside the radius or PinCodes
    Given the hospital is located at (12.345, 78.901)
    And the radius is set to 25 sqkm
    And the PinCodes are set to (123456, 789012)
    When a patient registers with an address outside the radius or PinCodes
    Then the patient cannot register and apply for appointments/consultation requests

  Scenario: Authorized Chemist per PinCode
    Given the hospital is located at (12.345, 78.901)
    And the PinCodes are set to (123456, 789012)
    When a patient registers with an address matching one of the PinCodes
    Then there is exactly one Authorized Chemist per PinCode

  Scenario: Prescription requests routed to Chemist
    Given the hospital is located at (12.345, 78.901)
    And the PinCodes are set to (123456, 789012)
    And a patient registers with an address matching one of the PinCodes
    When a prescription is requested
    Then the prescription is routed to the Chemist matching the patient's PinCode

  Scenario: Chemist delivers medicines through Offline delivery
    Given the hospital is located at (12.345, 78.901)
    And the PinCodes are set to (123456, 789012)
    And a patient registers with an address matching one of the PinCodes
    When a prescription is requested and delivered
    Then the Chemist delivers the medicines through Offline delivery

  Scenario: Chemist collects payments from Patients
    Given the hospital is located at (12.345, 78.901)
    And the PinCodes are set to (123456, 789012)
    And a patient registers with an address matching one of the PinCodes
    When a prescription is requested and delivered
    Then the Chemist collects payments from the Patient

  Scenario: Chemist marks Prescription on completion of delivery
    Given the hospital is located at (12.345, 78.901)
    And the PinCodes are set to (123456, 789012)
    And a patient registers with an address matching one of the PinCodes
    When a prescription is requested and delivered
    Then the Chemist marks the Prescription on completion of delivery

  Scenario: No systemic matching done to figure out efficiency of the Chemist
    Given the hospital is located at (12.345, 78.901)
    And the PinCodes are set to (123456, 789012)
    When a patient registers with an address matching one of the PinCodes
    Then no systemic matching is done to figure out the efficiency of the Chemist

  Scenario: Authorized Laboratory per PinCode or Zone
    Given the hospital is located at (12.345, 78.901)
    And the PinCodes are set to (123456, 789012)
    When a patient registers with an address matching one of the PinCodes
    Then there is exactly one Authorized Laboratory per PinCode or Zone
```
